simple.meaning: עֲרָבָה (ʻărâbâh) appears 61 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with priesthood.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, and 8 more, beginning at Numbers 22:1. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as commandment, priesthood, mountain, Israel.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows עֲרָבָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.short: a desert ; especially (with the article prefix) the (generally) sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea
definitions.usage: Arabah, champaign, desert, evening, heaven, plain, wilderness. See also 1026 .
definitions.full: H6160. arabah I. עֲרָבָה 61 noun feminine desert-plain, steppe ; — absolute ׳ע 2Sam 4:7 +, suffix עַרְבָתָהּ Isa 51:3 ; plural עֲרָבוֺת Jer 5:6 ; Psa 68:5 , construct עַרְבוֺת 2Kin 25:5 +, עַרְבֹת Jer 52:8 ; — 1 earliest use: a. arid steppe west of Dead Sea (in southern Judah) 1Sam 23:24 , also Ezek 47:8 ; Isa 51:3 , whence name הָע ׳יָם Josh 3:16 (JE) || הַמֶּלַח יָם ), also 2Kin 14:25 ; Deut 4:49 , and (|| id .) 3:17 ; Josh 12:3 (D); הָעֲרָבָה נַחַל Amos 6:14 must be east of Dead Sea, si vera lectio, but read probably ׳נ מִצְרַיִם see נַחַל . b. Jordan-valley west of river + adjacent plain ; near ford (opposite Jericho) 2Sam 2:29 , compare Josh 8:14 (JE); also Deut 11:30 ; 2Kin 25:4 = Jer 39:4 = 52:7 ; — 2Sam 15:28 ; 17:16 see עֲבָרָה c. Jordan-valley east of river 2Sam 4:7 . 2 in D: a. especially of east Jordan plain Deut 1:1 (probably) Josh 12:1 , 3 , east half of Jordan-valley Deut 3:17 ; 4:49 ; of entire Jordan-valley (between כִּנֶּרֶת and Dead Sea, modern El-Ghôr, the Depression ) 1:7 ; Josh 11:2 , 16 ; west Jordan plain only 12:8 ; depression south of Dead Sea (modern Wady el-`Arabah ) Deut 2:8 . 3 in P always plural construct מוֺאָב עַרְבוֺת (east Jordan) Num 22:1 11 t. (see מוֺאָב ); ׳ע עְרֵחוֺ (West Jordan) Josh 4:13 ; 5:10 , also 2Kin 25:5 = Jer 39:5 = 52:8 . 4 apparently North Arabian desert Isa 40:3 ; 41:19 . 5 in General the steppe (often || מִדְבָּר ), Jer 17:6 ; 50:12 ; Isa 33:9 ; 35:1 , 6 ; Job 24:5 ; 39:6 ; Psa 68:5 ; עֲרָבוֺת זְאֵב Jer 5:6 (figurative of invader); compare description of Exodus וְשׁוּחָה עֲרָבָה אֶרֶץ 2:6 ; in simile, of a plain , of future land of Judah Zech 14:10 . — See Dr Deut 1:1 and references Buhl Geogr. 111 . עַרְבָתִי see הָעֲרָבָה בֵּית V. ערב (√ of following; compare Assyrian erêbu , enter, go in ; erêb šamši , sunset ; Arabic set (distinct from depart , = Sabean עֿרב withdraw , according to DHM Epigr. Denkm. 27 ), place of sunset, west ; Sabean מערבי מערבם, [not עֿ !] west, western , CIS iv. p. 199 DHM l.c .; Ethiopic set (of heavenly bodies), so Syriac ; evening (Lag BN 64 f. ); Zinjirli מערב west ; Late Hebrew עֶרֶב = Biblical Hebrew. Hence also Εὐπώπη , Europe , Lewy Fremdw. 139 ).
